OER 12 Volt Universal Headlight Switch 1940-1955 Buick Chevy Oldsmobile and Pontiac Models

Universal fit, service replacement headlight switch and knob designed for fitment on a variety of GM models with 12 volt system. A convenient way to update your headlight switch when upgrading and converting your 6 volt system to 12 volt system. Each switch includes the shaft and knob.


Product Specifications

Universal Push Pull for Headlamp

5 Screw Terminals

3 Positions

Rating: 20 Amps @ 12 Volts DC With 11 ohms of Resistance

Push Pull Switch with Circuit Breaker

Rheostat - Turn to Dim Dashboard Light

Three Position Switch = OFF-ON-ON

Position 1 = Off

Position 2 = Tail, Park, and Dash

Position 3 = Tail, Dash, and Headlights

5 Screw Terminals (2 Stud Terminals)

Stem 3/8" Long 3/8" Diameter

Replaces GM 1994016, 1994022, 1995031, 1995035, 1995041, 1995045, 1995048, 1995052, D-1537
